Dave Matthews Band
May 21, 2022
Lakewood Amphitheatre - Atlanta, GA

*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*
*=*=*=*=* 24/48 RECORDING *=*=*=*=*
*=* NOT SUITABLE FOR CD BURNING *=*
*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 6 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Rear of FOH (Stage Right), DFC, Mics DIN @ 11'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.58 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 32/48) > Audacity 3.1.3 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Setlist:

02. You Might Die Trying
03. Madman's Eyes
04. When the World Ends
05. Proudest Monkey¹ >
06. Satellite
07. Can't Stop²
08. The Dreaming Tree³
09. Dancing Nancies
10. Sweet Up and Down
11. Stay or Leave
12. Crush⁴
13. The Only Thing
14. Again and Again
15. Two Step⁵
16. The Space Between
17. Jimi Thing⁶
18. What Would You Say
19. You & Me⁷
20. Ants Marching⁸
21. Encore Break
22. Time Bomb
23. Warehouse

Total Performance Time: [02:48:59.144]

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

¹ with Grazing in the Grass [Hugh Masekela] and Jamaican Farewell [Harry Belafonte] interpolations
² Dave scat intro
³ with Chocolate Rain [Tay Zonday] interpolation
⁴ Stefan solo intro
⁵ Time Bomb intro
⁶ first verse sung by crowd, I Want to Take You Higher (Sly & The Family Stone) outro
⁷ with extended intro
⁸ brief Carter solo intro

Loud clapper in the left channel, particularly in "Crush".

Huge thanks to the DMB Crew for letting me set up at FOH.

My undying gratitude to David Morris and Grace Morris [IG: @wardamnwagle] for the free ticket.

Thank you to Mark Terrell and Tyler Anderson for being the best concert buddies in the world.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers before me who continue to preserve live music.
